title: Attachment request rules
summary: Check attachment approval targets and constraints.
purpose: Check attachment approval targets and constraints.
request: Send one file per POST to {{route:attachments.upload_request}}. In chat, the file belongs to the current flow and needs no card target.
response: A `pending` request awaits approval. See `attachments/link` to find approved shared files.
errors: For `409 attachment_target_document_missing`, check the card document. For `413 attachment_request_too_large`, reduce the size. For `422 attachment_request_extension_blocked`, use an allowed format. `429` indicates a request limit.
